company.name: Skillful AI
company.shortDescription: Skillful AI is a technology platform that focuses on identifying, developing, and matching artificial intelligence talent.
company.description:
Skillful AI is a technology platform that focuses on identifying, developing, and matching artificial intelligence talent with organisations that require AI expertise. The platform provides tools to assess technical skills, evaluate competencies, and connect qualified professionals with companies seeking AI-related capabilities.

Skillful AI offers services that help organisations manage AI talent pipelines, evaluate candidate proficiency, and support workforce development in areas such as machine learning, data science, and automation technologies. The platform is designed to support recruitment, skill verification, and talent development processes.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $23,454,704 to $23,454,704, a 1x increase.
